title: Dusty Springfield – Golden Hits (8-Track Tape, Columbia House, VTG) PC-8 600-220
descriptionText:
Format: 8-Track Stereo Tape Cartridge
Artist: Dusty Springfield
Album: Golden Hits
Label: Columbia House / Philips / Mercury (PC-8 600-220)
Country: USA
Genre: Pop, Soul
Era: 1960s/1970s
Songs / Programs:
Goin’ Back / Stay Awhile / I Just Don’t Know What To Do With Myself
All I See Is You / Wishin’ and Hopin’ / Little By Little
My Coloring Book / All Cried Out / I Only Want To Be With You
In The Middle of Nowhere / You Don’t Have To Say You Love Me / Losing You
Condition:
Tape Cartridge: Acceptable vintage condition with visible wear, aging, and some label staining (see photos). Cartridge shell shows scuffs and discoloration typical of age.
Labels: Front and back labels show discoloration, scratches, and wear. Some text is faded.
Slipcase: Original Columbia House slipcase included. Box shows edge wear, surface scuffs, light staining, and some tears.
Untested: This tape has not been tested for playability. Being sold as a collectible only.
Please carefully review all provided photos as they are part of the item description.
Notes:
Rare Columbia House club edition of Dusty Springfield’s Golden Hits on 8-track.
A must-have for collectors of Dusty Springfield, vintage pop/soul, or Columbia House 8-tracks.
Highly collectible format, great display piece!
